strapiBlog.title: The Ultimate Guide to Dubai’s Burj Azizi: The World’s Second-Tallest Tower
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai is no stranger to breaking records, especially when it comes to architecture.

data.text:
Dubai is no stranger to breaking records, especially when it comes to real estate projects. From luxury towers to sprawling communities, the city continuously redefines architectural ambition, setting new benchmarks in luxury, innovation, and scale.

Already home to the world’s tallest building, the Burj Khalifa, the city is now set to add another monumental structure to its iconic skyline.  Burj Azizi Tower at Sheikh Zayed Road, a staggering 725-meter skyscraper, is ready to be launched on 19th February 2025. We’ve gathered all the key information about the soon-to-be world’s second-tallest tower. So, get ready to rise above the skyline!

About Burj Azizi Tower — A Masterpiece in the Making

Located along the bustling Sheikh Zayed Road in Dubai’s World Trade Center district, Burj Azizi is second only to the iconic Burj Khalifa, solidifying its place as a global architectural marvel.
Mirwais Azizi, founder and chairman of Azizi Developments, envisions the tower as a tribute to Dubai’s ambitious spirit. He remarked:

"My vision for Burj Azizi is to create a lasting legacy, a monumental achievement in engineering, and a tribute to Dubai as a destination of choice for both residents and visitors."

Standing at a staggering 725 meters (2,379 feet), the Burj Azizi Tower will feature 131+ floors of luxury living, retail, and leisure spaces, offering unparalleled experiences to residents and visitors alike.

Why Invest in Burj Azizi-The World’s Second-Tallest Tower?

Burj Azizi Tower isn’t just a skyscraper; it’s a lucrative investment opportunity. Here’s why:

  1. Prime Location: Situated in the heart of Dubai’s business hub, the World Trade Center district, the tower offers seamless connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah.
  2. Record-Breaking Features: From the world’s highest observation deck on the 130th floor to a seven-star hotel, the tower redefines luxury living.
  3. A Truly Global Destination: Burj Azizi has already captivated global attention, with launch events across key cities such as Dubai, London, New York, Tokyo, and more. This international appeal reinforces its position as a world-class investment that resonates across cultures and markets.
  4. Growing Real Estate Market: Dubai’s property market is booming. With a total investment of AED 6 billion, Burj Azizi is expected to fuel further growth in the sector.
  5. Golden Visa Benefits: Investors can leverage Dubai’s Golden Visa program, which offers long-term residency for property buyers.

What Sets Burj Azizi Apart?

The Burj Azizi Tower will be home to numerous world-firsts, offering unmatched luxury and amenities:

  • World’s Highest Lobby (498m) - Level 11
  • Highest Occupied Hotel Room (512m) - Level 118
  • Dubai’s Highest Restaurant (544m) - Level 122
  • World’s Highest Nightclub (567m) - Level 126
  • Highest Observation Deck (649m) - Level 130
  • Highest Spa (415m)
  • Highest Cinema and Supermarket (310m)

The Residences at the World’s Second-Tallest Tower

In addition to its hotel and retail offerings, Burj Azizi Tower at Sheikh Zayed Road will feature a range of luxury residences, including penthouses, apartments, and holiday homes. These residences are designed to offer a sanctuary in the sky, complete with expansive living spaces, floor-to-ceiling windows, and stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and the Dubai skyline.

The interiors will be nothing short of spectacular, with each residence boasting modern, high-end finishes and state-of-the-art amenities. Whether you’re a local looking for a prestigious address or an international investor seeking a prime real estate opportunity, Burj Azizi offers unparalleled living spaces.

Setting New Benchmarks in Engineering and Design

While the height of Burj Azizi is undoubtedly impressive, its true marvel lies in its design and engineering. The world's second-tallest skyscraper’s foundation and piling work is already well underway, with the developers having meticulously planned for the unique challenges that come with constructing a supertall building.

The project has been approved by Dubai’s General Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA), ensuring that the tower complies with the city’s strict regulations for tall structures. According to Mirwais Azizi, the developer initially had two designs—one for a 526-meter tower and one for the now-approved 725-meter version. With the green light from authorities, the project is moving ahead at full speed.

The Grand Launch Of Burj Azizi Tower

Get ready for any outstanding event! Burj Azizi, the iconic world’s second-tallest tower, is set to make its grand global debut on February 19th. The mega launch will take place at the following locations around the world:

  • Dubai: Conrad Hotel
  • New York: Marriott Downtown
  • London: The Dorchester
  • Tokyo: Palace Hotel
  • Sydney: Four Seasons Hotel
  • Singapore: Marina Bay Sands
  • Mumbai: JW Marriott Juhu
  • Hong Kong: The Peninsula

Don’t miss your chance to be part of the future!

Property Values Near Burj Azizi Expected to Soar 

The construction of Burj Azizi, set to be the world’s second-tallest tower, is expected to dramatically boost the value of properties in the Dubai World Trade Center and Sheikh Zayed Road area and neighboring communities, including DIFC, Emirates Tower, and Al Satwa. Some nearby properties include Liberty Houses, DIFC Living, and Four Seasons Private Residences.

As a global landmark, the 725-meter tower will attract international attention, creating a surge in demand for real estate in its vicinity. The prestigious location, combined with proximity to one of Dubai’s newest architectural icons, will make the surrounding properties highly sought-after, leading to significant value appreciation.

The Future of Dubai’s Skyline

As Burj Azizi rises, it will join a host of other towering developments that are set to reshape Dubai’s skyline. The Burj Binghatti Jacob & Co Residences, for example, is set to become the world’s tallest residential structure, while the Ciel Tower in Dubai Marina will claim the title of world’s tallest hotel. With these projects, Dubai is not just building higher; it’s building better, creating iconic landmarks that redefine luxury living and engineering excellence.

Burj Azizi is more than just a building; it’s a symbol of Dubai’s limitless ambition and a testament to its position as a global leader in real estate and architectural innovation. Once completed, it will stand as the world’s second-tallest tower, offering a unique blend of luxury, convenience, and cutting-edge design. With its impressive range of record-breaking features, prime location, and unparalleled amenities, Burj Azizi is set to become one of the most iconic landmarks in the world.

faqs.question: What is the location of Burj Azizi?

data.answer: The tower is located in Dubai’s World Trade Center district along Sheikh Zayed Road, offering easy access to major attractions, business hubs, and leisure destinations.

faqs.question: What floor is the observation deck on in Burj Azizi?

data.answer: The observation deck is on the 130th floor, providing breathtaking 360-degree views of Dubai.
Investing in Burj Azizi Tower means owning a piece of architectural history, with its prime location, unparalleled amenities, and potential for high returns in Dubai’s booming real estate market.

faqs.question: What are the other off-plan projects by Azizi Developments?

data.answer:
Azizi Developments offers several notable projects, including:

  • Beach Oasis 2 at Dubai Studio City.
  • Azizi Venice at Dubai South.
  • Azizi Neila at Al Furjan.

These developments highlight Azizi’s commitment to innovative designs and premium living experiences.

faqs.question: Currently, what is the second tallest building in the world?

data.answer: For now, Merdeka 118 in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, holds the title of the second-tallest building at 678.9 meters. However, once completed, Burj Azizi Tower will surpass it, standing at an impressive 725 meters.

faqs.question: How many floors are in Burj Azizi?

data.answer: Burj Azizi, presently under construction along Dubai's Sheikh Zayed Road, is set to rise 725 meters high and feature more than 131 floors.
